newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium's Maystadt favours ASLK bourse listing.
newsitem.headline: Belgium's Maystadt favours ASLK bourse listing.

text.p: Belgian Finance Minister Philippe Maystadt said he favoured a stock market listing as the next move in the privatisation process of ASLK-CGER bank.

"A listing would be good. First, to have a reference framework for the price. Second, because otherwise ASLK would be the only one of the five major banks which would not be listed on the bourse, which would be bizarre. Third, because it would be a good operation for Brussels as a financial centre," he said.
The government wants to reduce the state's stake in ASLK to about 25 percent from its current 49.9 percent.
It is currently in talks with Belgian-Dutch insurance and banking group Fortis, to which it sold 49.9 percent just over three years ago.
Fortis has the right of first refusal on additional ASLK shares to be sold.
